XData.name: UrlMap
XData.Data: <Routes> <!-- <Route Url="/class/:namespace/:classname" Method="GET" Call="invokeGetService" Cors="true"/> <Map Prefix="/docserver" Forward="%Api.v1.DocServer"/> --> <Route Url="/deathDatePost" Method="POST" Call="invokePostService"/> </Routes>

Method.name: invokePostService
Method.Implementation:
w "Invoking PostService",!
#dim %request AS %CSP.Request
// Make Dynamic Object From Request set content = ##class(%DynamicObject).%FromJSON(%request.Content)
w "Dynamic Object Created",!
set tSC = ##class(Ens.Director).CreateBusinessService("In-Utah-Demogr-Json-Wsr-DEATHDATE", .svc)
w "Business Service Create",! w "Calling OnProcessInput",! do svc.OnProcessInput(content,.tResponse)
w "OnProcessInput Complete",!
set tSC = ##class(Ens.Util.JSON).ObjectToJSONStream(tResponse,.tStream)
w "Reading in JSON To A Steam",!
write tStream.Read()
quit 1
